## 安装

- 需要 iOS 26.1 或更高。
- 下载 `Tonari-{{VERSION}}-unsigned.ipa`，用侧载工具（例如 Sideloadly、AltStore / SideStore）或自己的证书签名后安装。
- 用同一个 Apple ID / 证书签名覆盖安装，数据会保留。换证书或 Bundle ID 相当于换了一个 App，数据要靠备份恢复，见[使用说明](https://github.com/leorxx11/Tonari/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md#备份与换签名)。

功能介绍见 [README](https://github.com/leorxx11/Tonari#readme)，导入规则与字幕关联见[使用说明](https://github.com/leorxx11/Tonari/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md)。

## Install

- Requires iOS 26.1 or later.
- Download `Tonari-{{VERSION}}-unsigned.ipa` and sign it with a sideloading tool (for example Sideloadly or AltStore / SideStore) or your own certificate.
- Sign with the same Apple ID or certificate and install over the previous version to keep your data. A different certificate or Bundle ID makes a different app, so restore your data from a backup, see the [usage guide](https://github.com/leorxx11/Tonari/blob/main/docs/USAGE.en.md#backups-and-re-signing).
